description: Profile card with malformed and inaccessible markup.
defects: Missing lang attribute; h2, p and the card div are never closed; the body has no closing html tag.
Duplicate id 'card'; the avatar image has no alt text.
Follow is an anchor without href driven by an inline onclick; close is a span showing 'x' with no accessible name.
Inline style and inline event handler attributes.
Global body, h2 and p selectors leak into the host page; the 420px fixed width plus margin overflows at 360px.
prompt_suffix: Repair the markup in place without changing what the card shows: valid, balanced HTML with a lang attribute, unique ids, alt text on the avatar, no inline style or on* handler attributes, a real Follow button that changes its text to 'Following' when clicked, and a real close button with the accessible name 'Close card'. Keep the root element class 'card', scope the CSS to the card, and avoid fixed widths that overflow a 360px viewport.
